title: Glowing violin
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd37a' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb347' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='46' y='14' width='8' height='34' rx='3' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <rect x='46' y='14' width='8' height='34' rx='3' fill='#d98436' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- scroll -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='13' r='6' fill='#e08a3c'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='13' r='3' fill='#ffd37a'/>
  <!-- pegbox pegs -->
  <rect x='40' y='20' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <rect x='53' y='20' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <rect x='40' y='27' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <rect x='53' y='27' width='7' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <!-- fingerboard -->
  <rect x='47' y='32' width='6' height='22' fill='#3b2a5a'/>
  <!-- upper bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='17' ry='12' fill='#c16b22'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='17' ry='12' fill='#e8892f' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- waist -->
  <rect x='36' y='63' width='28' height='6' fill='#c16b22'/>
  <!-- lower bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='23' ry='16' fill='#d97a28'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='23' ry='16' fill='#ffb347' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- edge highlight lower -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='21' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#ffd37a' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- edge highlight upper -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='15' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#ffd37a' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- f-holes -->
  <path d='M42 66 q-3 5 0 10' stroke='#3b2a5a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 66 q3 5 0 10' stroke='#3b2a5a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='43' y='71' width='14' height='3' rx='1' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <!-- tailpiece -->
  <path d='M47 75 L53 75 L52 87 L48 87 Z' fill='#3b2a5a'/>
  <!-- strings -->
  <line x1='48' y1='33' x2='47.5' y2='85' stroke='#fff3c4' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.9'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='33' x2='50' y2='85' stroke='#fff3c4' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.9'/>
  <line x1='52' y1='33' x2='52.5' y2='85' stroke='#fff3c4' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- chinrest hint -->
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='72' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#5a3d7a' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
